name: My data pack (template)
author: Your name
description: A template showing every field of a bod3 data pack. Change the values, delete what you do not need, and import it from Settings → Data packs. PIDs may only use read services (01, 09, 22). Formulas use A, B, C … for the data bytes after the response header, e.g. (A*256+B)/4.

pids.name: Coolant temperature (example)
pids.notes: Broadcast request (no header): any ECU may answer.

pids.name: Engine ECU identifier F40C (example)
pids.notes: UDS read sent to one ECU (11-bit CAN request/response IDs).

vehicles.notes: ECU list shown on the vehicle screen and used to name and probe modules during a scan.
